items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: And he brought Mike over there and he says, Mike, I want you to meet Snoozer Quinn.

ctx.x: Oh, no. We're just thinking now. Who was Bea Palmer?

Bea Palmer was the one that Emmett played to dance. Bea Palmer was the shimmy queen. Now you're talking about up with Mike Fritzel and them up in Friars in Chicago. You have a very attentive mind, young man, I might say.
Well, see, I review all of this stuff.
